recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成熟脂肪細胞之間的纖細間質中，夾有小型深染圓核的紅血球前驅細胞、帶顆粒胞質的骨髓系細胞，以及少數較大、核較開放的細胞，顯示脂肪組織內含多系造血細胞，符合腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Large empty adipocyte vacuoles separated by thin hematopoietic cords
Small round cells with dense, dark nuclei consistent with late erythroid precursors
Cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and segmented or band-like nuclei consistent with maturing granulocytes
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm (immature hematopoietic cells or megakaryocytic forms)
Admixed red cells and delicate capillaries; no atypical stromal cells or lipoblasts
describe_en: Higher-power section shows mature adipocytes separated by thin cords of hematopoietic tissue. The cords contain small erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei, maturing granulocytic cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, and occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei, together with red cells and delicate capillaries. There are no lipoblasts or cytologically atypical stromal cells. Findings are consistent with the hematopoietic component of an adrenal myelolipoma.

ddx.vs: Shows atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts in fibrous septa rather than maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors.
Morphologically the hematopoietic cells are identical, but EMH arises in the setting of marrow failure or hemoglobinopathy and lacks a discrete fat-predominant encapsulated mass.
Contains foamy histiocytes, lipid cysts and mixed inflammatory cells rather than orderly maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors.
